producthunt.name: Product Hunt MCP
producthunt.tagline: The community you trust in the assistant you use
producthunt.description: Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

producthunt.name: Dageno AI 2.0
producthunt.tagline: See why AI recommends your competitors instead of you
producthunt.description: AI is now choosing brands for your customers. Dageno AI is an AEO/GEO platform that shows whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and 7 more AI models recommend you or your competitors, and which sources drive those answers. Look up any market for free, forever: see top brands, buyer questions and cited sources across 12,000+ niche markets and 3M+ brands. Upgrade only when you need to track your own prompts. Built for brands and agencies.

producthunt.name: Databox CLI
producthunt.tagline: Your agentic analytics platform in the terminal
producthunt.description: Create data sources, load data, build metrics, and automate workflows directly from your terminal. Use 90+ commands yourself, or let AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex do the work with 10 ready-to-use agent skills.

producthunt.name: AXL
producthunt.tagline: GTM copilot for AI product founders: 1,200+ actions via MCP
producthunt.description: Capture leads, close sales & onboard customers in one system: pages, quizzes, webinars, courses, video hosting & streaming, email, chat, CRM, telephony & AI calls. No integrations to build & maintain. Every interaction enriches each lead's history. Our AI model, trained on 1M deals from AXL users, scores leads using 300+ signals to help your AI & sales team decide who to follow up with, when & how. Give ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor access to lead context & 1,200+ sales & marketing actions via MCP.
